title: Company Alignment Sprint Zero - Comms, Exec Notes, OKR Triage
content:
Purpose:
- Create a compact, action-oriented working doc for the company-level kickoff ("Sprint Zero") to converge on priorities, finalize top-level OKRs, and prepare executive talking points and comms. This is intentionally concise — the working inputs that will feed the formal all-hands materials.

Scope:
- Audience: Exec team, IC owners of cross-functional initiatives, product leads, people ops.
- Deliverables by EOW: revised top-3 company OKRs (version we show public), a 25-minute all-hands run of show, exec talking points (1 slide each), and a 48-hour escalation runbook for launch week.

Quick context notes (working):
- Business context: Q1 bookings and Dedicated renewals have a higher variability than we modeled. Ops: need clearer routing plan for Dedicated leads.
- Engineering: serving-runtime has two capacity-impacting migrations planned — we need canaries + failback documented. See ENG-4821.
- Product: Optimize initiative will recommend a quantization profile in Jan — may change expected cost savings by ~8–12%.

Proposed company-level OKRs (draft, for debate):
O1: Make inference predictable and cost-efficient for customers
  KR1.1: Reduce median per-token cost for hosted text-generation customers by 15% vs baseline (Dec 2025)
  KR1.2: Deploy autoscaling + burst capacity to Dedicated customers with 99.5% success for 95th percentile throughput
  KR1.3: Ship prefix/KV caching feature with SDK hooks and two pilot customers onboarded

O2: Improve reliability and graceful degradation across deployments
  KR2.1: Achieve platform-wide P95 tail-latency SLO of <300ms for short-chat requests (<=128 tokens) in hosted regions
  KR2.2: Establish fallback routing for model variants and demonstrate end-to-end failover in 3 regional exercises
  KR2.3: Reduce severity-1 incident time-to-restore (MTTR) by 30% vs last year baseline

O3: Expand enterprise adoption for Private and Dedicated
  KR3.1: Close 6 Dedicated contracts with >=6-month committed spend
  KR3.2: Deliver audited Private on-prem deployment checklist and 3 pilot customer deployments
  KR3.3: Launch compliance packaged offering (SOC2+ISO) and sign first commercial SLA addendum

Notes on these OKRs (open questions):
- Are these KRs measurable with current telemetry? Product/Observability to confirm instrumentation gaps by Tue.
- Should we fold quantization-led savings into O1 or put them in a new cost-optimization sub-OKR?
- Priority tension between O1 (cost) and O2 (latency) for Optimize recommendations — need product/rt-engineering alignment.

Executive talking points (1–2 bullets each, raw):
- CEO (Avery): Frame mission: "Serving is the moat"; high-level FY26 ask: invest to reduce unit costs while protecting latency. Call out two customer stories briefly (Dedicated pilot, Private pilot).
- CTO (Samir): Technical ask: commit to two cross-team migrations (kernel-selector rollout; KV cache rollout) with clear rollback gates. Share risk matrix.
- Head of Product (Lina): Roadmap highlights: hosted feature parity, Optimize beta metrics, Dedicated autoscale policy. Call for product-test partners.
- Head of Sales (Jordan): GTM ask: focus effort on 6 target accounts; outline support needed from solutions and infra for proofs-of-concept.

All-hands (Sprint Zero) run of show (25 minutes):
- 0:00–02:00 — Opening & framing (Avery)
- 02:00–07:00 — State snapshot: performance, bookings, pilot highlights (Samir + Jordan)
- 07:00–15:00 — Top OKRs & exec asks (Avery + Lina): present each OKR (2 min each), raise risks and needs
- 15:00–22:00 — Quick tech demo / customer vignette (serving-runtime + customer success)
- 22:00–25:00 — Close & call to action (Hiring, small teams, volunteers for pilots), how to raise concerns (triage flow)

Pre-reads (to be posted 48h prior):
- One-pager: top-3 OKRs and what they mean for each function (1 page)
- Metrics snapshot: bookings runway, latency histogram, Dedicated capacity utilization
- Two short customer vignettes (one Dedicated, one Private)

Communications plan (internal + public):
- Internal (day of): post slides + FAQ to #company-updates; Triage channel: #sprint-zero-ops (ops owners on-call 72h)
- External (post-all-hands): short blog + customer email highlighting roadmap themes, not granular technical commitments — coordinate with comms/legal on wording (TBD)

Risk register (quick; owners in parentheses):
- Risk: Serving-runtime migration causes elevated tail-latency during canary (Samir). Mitigation: staggered canary, automatic rollback, synthetic load tests pre-canary. Escalation: SRE on-call, exec pager.
- Risk: Dedicated sales pipeline momentum stalls due to unclear SLAs (Jordan). Mitigation: accelerate Dedicated SLA drafting with legal + solutions.
- Risk: Telemetry gaps for cost KPIs (Evelyn). Mitigation:Obs tickets to instrument missing meters, instrument rollout prioritized.

Decision log (initial):
- D1 (draft): Prioritize cost workstream (O1) for Q1 resource allocation; exec agreed to fund two FTE contractor slots for Optimize during Jan–Mar. (owner: Finance/Product)
- D2 (draft): Use regional fallback policy as default for hosted API in December trial (owner: Platform Eng)

Immediate action items (this doc is an action tracker):
- Lina: produce 1-page OKR summary for each function by Tue 2025-11-18 (Jira: PRD-9001).
- Samir: publish migration risk matrix + canary schedule by Thu 2025-11-20 (linked to ENG-4821).
- Evelyn (obs): list telemetry gaps and estimated effort for fixes by Mon 2025-11-17.
- Jordan: identify 8 target accounts and nominate 2 pilot opportunities by Fri 2025-11-21.

Open questions for Exec sync (to discuss in Fri 11/22 meeting):
- Are we comfortable with the 15% cost reduction target (O1 KR1.1) given Optimize's current coverage?
- Do we want a public-facing OKR set or a condensed product-focused set for customers?
- How aggressive should we be with Dedicated capacity commitments in Q1?

Notes to self / working comments (rough):
- Keep narrative simple: mission -> problem -> ask. Avoid technical jargon in CEO slide.
- We need a short FAQ anticipating cost vs latency tradeoff questions. Lina to draft.
- Check with legal on phrasing for "SLA-backed" in external comms — avoid commitments until legal review.

Appendix — quick links/placeholders: (add here as we assemble)
- Confluence: ALIGN-2025-sprint-zero (working page)
- Obs dashboard snapshot link (placeholder)
- Customer vignette drafts (CS to attach)

This is an intentionally messy, collaborative document. Please add edits inline, flag anything that must be queued into project boards, and tag owners on the action items.

-- End of draft --
